info.title: The machine a figure was taken on

MACHINE_CLASS_FIELDS.description: What identifies the machine a figure was taken on (plugin-qualify#115): a verdict for a host profile reads only figures of the class it names.

oneOf.title: arch
oneOf.description: The machine architecture as uname -m names it.
oneOf.x-text: The machine architecture, as uname -m names it.

oneOf.title: family
oneOf.x-text: The CPU family and model.

oneOf.title: coreBand
oneOf.description: The cores, as a band of MACHINE_CORE_BANDS.
oneOf.x-text: The core count, as a band of MACHINE_CORE_BANDS.

oneOf.title: clockBand
oneOf.description: The clock, as a band of MACHINE_CLOCK_BANDS.
oneOf.x-text: The clock, as a band of MACHINE_CLOCK_BANDS.

oneOf.title: preemptRt
oneOf.x-text: Whether the kernel is PREEMPT_RT.

oneOf.title: cstatesLimited
oneOf.description: Whether the deep idle states are limited.
oneOf.x-text: Whether the deep idle states are limited.

MACHINE_PROFILE_FIELDS.description: How the machine was set when a figure was taken: the frequency policy and isolation a figure depends on.

oneOf.title: governor
oneOf.x-text: The CPU frequency governor in effect when the figure was taken.

oneOf.title: turbo
oneOf.x-text: Whether turbo or boost clocking was enabled when the figure was taken.

oneOf.title: smt
oneOf.x-text: Whether simultaneous multithreading was enabled when the figure was taken.

oneOf.title: preempt
oneOf.x-text: Whether the measuring thread ran under real-time preemption, or scheduled as any other thread.

oneOf.title: cpuidle
oneOf.x-text: The CPU idle driver or policy in effect when the figure was taken.

MACHINE_CORE_BANDS.description: The bands a machine's core count falls in, ascending.

oneOf.title: cores1To2
oneOf.x-text: A machine with 1 to 2 cores.

oneOf.title: cores3To4
oneOf.x-text: A machine with 3 to 4 cores.

oneOf.title: cores5To8
oneOf.x-text: A machine with 5 to 8 cores.

oneOf.title: cores9To16
oneOf.x-text: A machine with 9 to 16 cores.

oneOf.title: cores17To32
oneOf.x-text: A machine with 17 to 32 cores.

oneOf.title: cores33Up
oneOf.x-text: A machine with 33 or more cores.

MACHINE_CLOCK_BANDS.description: The bands a machine's clock falls in, ascending.

oneOf.title: under1500MHz
oneOf.x-text: A machine clocked under 1.5 GHz.

oneOf.title: from1500To2500MHz
oneOf.x-text: A machine clocked from 1.5 to 2.5 GHz.

oneOf.title: from2500To3500MHz
oneOf.x-text: A machine clocked from 2.5 to 3.5 GHz.

oneOf.title: from3500To4500MHz
oneOf.x-text: A machine clocked from 3.5 to 4.5 GHz.

oneOf.title: from4500MHz
oneOf.x-text: A machine clocked at 4.5 GHz or more.

MACHINE_ARCHES.description: The architectures a host profile names, as uname -m spells them.

oneOf.title: x8664
oneOf.x-text: An x86-64 machine, as uname -m spells it.

oneOf.title: aarch64
oneOf.x-text: An AArch64 machine, as uname -m spells it.
